I was contemplating by getting this or the cosrx all in one . Im so indecisive so I just got both lol. I have combo skin and these were both super moisturizing and left a plumped velvety finish. The cosrx snail all in one cream is def a AM cream if u have my skin type . Not to heavy but definitely moisturizing especially paired with the snail essence. This Hyloronic acid cream is used in my pm since it's a bit thicker. THEEE LONGEVITY OF MOISTURE🙌🏽. Leaves your skin super plumped and juicy. Glad I got both ! I recommend both creams.

I finally finished this jar and had to finally leave my review. For context I have sensitive dry skin that gets red and angry in the wintertime. This is such a thick and smooth/creamy moisturizer and it keeps my skin feeling WET! I use it overnight and it has been wonderful with keeping me hydrated. It's a little heavy but I personally love that especially for the winter months but I also don't get acne often so maybe someone with frequent acne may have a different response to this sort of moisturizer? Regardless, I loved it and it reminds me of Neutrogena's gel moisturizer for half the price. It also tends to slip under makeup but it's just because my foundation is oil based and this moisturizer is water based so = separation. Still a 5/5 though since I only use it as an overnight moisturizer.

avis.titre: Wow. Tried so many moisturizers and…
avis.texte: If you suffer from dry skin and have tried many moisturizers, stop and buy this. I always had to use nivea cream on top of my previous moisturizers, just to still end up with dry patches. This works so well that I don't need the nivea cream anymore!

This moisturizer is perfect for hydrating skin in the winter. It has no scent, is gentle, and suitable for sensitive skin. My skin tends to break out and get dry due to dermatitis and ever wince I started using this, it is so hydrated and looks amazing and plump. I use this at night. Not sure if it'd work well under makeup.

I purchased this moisturizer about a month ago and have been blown away with how great it is. I have oily skin and I know that having hydrated skin is an important part of combating oily skin. I try to use a heavier moisturizer in the winter and a lighter one during the summer. I have used other cream moisturizers before, but this one literally keeps my skin hydrated the whole day! This moisturizer may be a bit heavy for the summer, but I would love to use this year round. I was deciding between this one and Snail 92 moisturizer and wanted to go with this product since I have sensitive skin.

This is an amazing moisturizer for night. You will wake up noticing a difference on night one. I don't use this in the morning because I feel like makeup does not sit well on it and it doesn't have sunscreen.
Better than the snail mucin!! This is totally an AquaBomb dupe, just slightly thicker consistency. A little goes a long way, this stuff is liquid gold
Combination skin. Works great for dry skin and peeling during skin purging. Only downside is the shine and tackiness.

This is one of the best moisturizers I've used…it might even be my holy grail tbh. I have very dry, flaky, sensitive skin, so dry I used the Clinique moisture overnight mask as a regular day/night cream. I struggle with acne too, and I've been looking for a non-comedogenic cream. A lot of creams use shea butter or very heavy ingredients that can clog pores, but after looking a while I found this cream. So far this hasn't broke me out. First, this moisturizer is not nearly as thick as the Clinique one but somehow moisturizes my skin way more. It's like a gel cream but once on it's very rich without being heavy. Second, this is the first cream that I've used that still leaves my skin moisturized and soft in the morning. I would 100% recommend this !
I love this product , so hydrating and makes my skin so smooth

I topically don't do reviews on products but I've been using this product for years now and I absolutely cannot do without it! The moisturizer gives that dewy look which I love! If you're not into that, then move along, this product is not for you. However, if you are like me and love it, continue reading. With is product a little goes a LONG way. Just one dab of moisturizer on each half of my face does the job. This is great because you don't have to put a lot of the product in your face. Thus, allowing you to save money in the long run. Also, this moisturizer is good for day AND night. However, if you learn more towards the drier side, you may want to consider getting a heavier cream for at night, especially during the winter.
This is great! This is the type of moisturizer that all skin types can use, it's lightweight but really hydrating and nourishing! 100% recommend

This is one of my absolute favorite moisturizers! It's a very interesting consistency. It feels and looks like a gel moisturizer initially, but as you smooth it into the skin, it feels very emollient and rich. As if it were a thicker, richer cream. It plumps the skin well and even helps make my pores appear smaller. My skin feels and looks gorgeous with it. I sincerely hope this is never discontinued!
